Prompts

```
['generate a video from a text prompt using the AllegroPipeline with guidance_scale and num_inference_steps', 'encode a text prompt into T5 text embeddings using AllegroPipeline encode_prompt method', 'prepare initial noisy latents for video generation using prepare_latents with specified shape and dtype', 'decode latent tensors back to video frames using the VAE decode_latents method', 'prepare 3D rotary positional embeddings for the transformer using _prepare_rotary_positional_embeddings']
```

Usage

```
{'generate_video_from_prompt': 'generate a video from a text prompt using the AllegroPipeline with guidance_scale and num_inference_steps', 'encode_prompt_text_embeddings': 'encode a text prompt into T5 text embeddings using AllegroPipeline encode_prompt method', 'prepare_latents_for_generation': 'prepare initial noisy latents for video generation using prepare_latents with specified shape and dtype', 'decode_latents_to_frames': 'decode latent tensors back to video frames using the VAE decode_latents method', 'configure_rotary_embeddings': 'prepare 3D rotary positional embeddings for the transformer using _prepare_rotary_positional_embeddings'}
```
